states.CITATION_ELIGIBLE: Target paper is in {ACCEPTED_IN_PRESS, PUBLISHED} and has an authoritative citation date.
states.CITATION_NOT_YET_ELIGIBLE: Target paper is PLANNED, DRAFT, or SUBMITTED, or lacks an authoritative publication date.
states.CITATION_CHRONOLOGICALLY_INVALID: Citing manuscript draft date precedes cited paper publication date.
states.CITATION_SCIENTIFICALLY_RELEVANT: Declared functional, architectural, or methodological interface exists.
states.CITATION_SCIENTIFICALLY_IRRELEVANT: No direct domain dependency; citation would be gratuitous or inflationary.
states.CITATION_PRESENT: Citation key or bibliography entry is physically found in actual .tex source file.
states.CITATION_REQUIRED: A direct theoretical or experimental dependency exists where citation is scientifically mandatory.
states.CITATION_OPTIONAL: Related work or contextual background reference.
states.CITATION_SYNCHRONIZATION_REQUIRED: Existing reference in manuscript requires DOI, venue, or BibTeX key sync.
states.CITATION_REQUIRES_HUMAN_REVIEW: Proposed insertion of a new citation into scientific prose requiring author judgment.
